summaryZh: Mesirov 实验室将机器学习与统计方法应用于功能基因组数据，以理解疾病机制、区分治疗结局并寻找药物靶点。团队开发开放源代码分析工具，并在癌症基因组学中开发分子标记和基因集富集分析等方法。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子标记能够辅助癌症的诊断、预后判断和治疗？

evidence.quote: Research in the Mesirov lab focuses on applying machine-learning and statistical methods to functional genomics data with the goal of better understanding the underlying biological mechanisms of disease, improving stratification of patients with respect to different treatment outcomes, and identifying novel drug targets.
Our lab is committed to the development of practical, accessible, open source software tools
a statistical methodology called Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA)
Jill Mesirov Lab GenomeSpace data analysis platform

We develop and apply new machine learning and statistical techniques to find molecular markers to aid in the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of cancer as well as to understand the underlying biological processes.
